title: Agent Plugins 1.0
author: Agent Plugins
why_it_matters: Agent Plugins 1.0 defines a vendor-neutral package format for skills, MCP servers, and client extensions, making agent capabilities portable across compatible clients.
actionable_takeaway: Create a Portable Agent Plugin Intake checklist covering manifest, fixed component locations, path boundary, permissions, side effects, and rollback.

title: Compatible Clients for Agent Plugins
author: Agent Plugins
why_it_matters: The compatible client list includes VS Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT & Codex, and other agent surfaces, so one plugin package may appear across multiple workbenches.
actionable_takeaway: Keep plugin capability and permission records cross-client rather than tied to one app name.

title: Agent Plugins loading and discovery
author: Agent Plugins
why_it_matters: The loading contract requires clients to load plugin.json first, discover only fixed component locations, and enforce package-root containment.
actionable_takeaway: Treat plugin intake like a strict supermarket shelf list: manifest first, fixed paths only, no path escape, isolate component failures.

title: Agent Plugins client conformance checklist
author: Agent Plugins
why_it_matters: The checklist turns plugin behavior into verifiable inputs: closed schema, supported components, isolated failures, MCP transport handling, and version matching.
actionable_takeaway: Use the conformance checklist as a pre-install gate before enabling any new skill or MCP bundle in Codex-like workbenches.

title: ChatGPT release notes - August 21, 2026
author: OpenAI Help
why_it_matters: The August 21 ChatGPT notes combine improved plugin discovery, local-time awareness, faster long conversations, progressive interactive replies, and iOS attachment updates.
actionable_takeaway: For mobile and long-session workflows, record plugin discovery, local time, progressive output, and attachment permissions separately.

title: ChatGPT release notes - August 20, 2026
author: OpenAI Help
why_it_matters: The August 20 notes put Sites URL changes, Apple Messages, Computer History, and read-only Codex snapshots into the same release surface, raising cross-app and share-boundary issues.
actionable_takeaway: Before sharing or sending from desktop workflows, classify public summary, private process, and local evidence; require recipient/message approval for messaging paths.

title: OpenAI API changelog - request-level regional processing
author: OpenAI API
why_it_matters: OpenAI API customers can select regional processing for individual requests by using a prefixed domain with an eligible project, bringing geography into the request envelope.
actionable_takeaway: Add request geography, project eligibility, endpoint, model, and retention requirements to API task templates.

title: OpenAI API changelog - Prompt Caching dashboard
author: OpenAI API
why_it_matters: The Prompt Caching dashboard exposes cache hit rate, cache reads per write, and cached versus uncached token breakdowns by model and service tier.
actionable_takeaway: Track prompt cache efficiency next to model, service tier, latency, and cost when evaluating reusable agent workflows.

title: Codex releases - 0.150.0 alpha cadence
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: Codex release listings show 0.150.0-alpha.7 and multiple recent 0.150 alpha builds after 0.149.0, indicating fast-moving CLI/runtime behavior.
actionable_takeaway: Record Codex version and release date in automation evidence; do not assume alpha features are installed locally.

title: Codex release 0.149.0
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: Codex 0.149.0 added agents dashboard, codex queue, codex doctor diagnostics, exact CLI config overrides, and max/ultra reasoning effort in SDK paths.
actionable_takeaway: Make queue status, doctor summary, config overrides, reasoning level, and final owner part of the publish gate.

title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases - August 10
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: GitHub's weekly update combines Agent Plugins 1.0, plugin management, side chat, /tasks, queueing, /rewind, app context preservation, memory, and BYOK/local model signals.
actionable_takeaway: Design long-running agent work as queueable, reversible, context-preserving sessions with a side-question lane.

title: The new GitHub Copilot experience in Slack
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: GitHub brings Copilot CLI/app agent capabilities into Slack public preview, including triage, issue updates, implementation, validation, pull requests, and code channels.
actionable_takeaway: Use Slack as a shared dispatch and steering surface, but require PR review, extra approval for agent-authored PRs, and platform/local validation before merge.

title: Shared agentic work with GitHub Copilot in Microsoft Teams
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: Teams can start shared Copilot cloud agent sessions from discussions, continue across surfaces, and govern usage via cloud agent budgets and extra approval requirements.
actionable_takeaway: Turn meeting action items into a ChatOps Shared-Agent Envelope with repo, permissions, budget, sandbox, approval, and continuation surface.

title: Enterprise managed settings in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now supports enterprise managed settings for plugin governance, MCP server allowlists, OpenTelemetry, and organization-controlled permission modes.
actionable_takeaway: Create an Enterprise Agent Controls Matrix for plugins, marketplaces, MCP servers, telemetry capture, and permission modes.
